|game_text=Deploy on Sidious. If with [Virtual Block 5] Expand the Empire during your control phase: relocate this card to an [Episode I] Jedi at a battleground or Senate (otherwise, retrieve 1 Force). If on a Jedi, add one battle destiny here, and if that Jedi just lost, relocate this card to Sidious.
|errata_history=This is errata version PC-E1 (version 2 of 4). No published image shows this text, so the image here is a CardMaker recreation of it ([[:File:VB5-20-Order_66-PC-E1-cardmaker.png]], made 11 November 2026). The current text is [[Order 66 (Errata 3)]] (PC-E3), which has the original words again.
* '''Original''' ([[Order 66]]): Virtual Block 5 release sheet, official text as of 7 December 2009 (slip 20)<ref name="sheet-VirtualBlock5">[https://res.starwarsccg.org/legacyblocks/VirtualBlock5.pdf#page=3 Virtual Block 5 release sheet] ("Official text as of 7 December 2009"; copy re-made 1 April 2010, first printing not found), page 3, slip 20. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261027095234/https://res.starwarsccg.org/legacyblocks/VirtualBlock5.pdf#page=3 Internet Archive]</ref>: “Deploy on Sidious. If with [Virtual Block 5] Expand The Empire during your control phase: relocate this card to an [Episode I] Jedi at a battleground or Senate (otherwise, retrieve 1 Force). If on a Jedi, add one battle destiny here, and if that Jedi just lost, relocate this card to Sidious.” The release-sheet slip ([[:File:VB5-20-Order_66.png]]) prints it. '''Document:''' release-sheet slip; slip number “20” bottom right, the Virtual Block 5 set mark.
* '''PC-E1''' (this page): PC website card list, Virtual Block 5 list and Virtual master list, first archived 21 July 2012 (every capture with game text to 11 January 2013)<ref name="cl-1250_20">Players Committee website card list (Internet Archive captures): VBlock5Type (Virtual Block 5 list) [https://web.archive.org/web/20120721064732/http://www.starwarsccg.org/cardlists/VBlock5Type.html 21 July 2012], [https://web.archive.org/web/20121211205224/http://www.starwarsccg.org/cardlists/VBlock5Type.html 11 December 2012], [https://web.archive.org/web/20130111153832/http://www.starwarsccg.org/cardlists/VBlock5Type.html 11 January 2013]; VMasterType (Virtual master list) [https://web.archive.org/web/20120721064754/http://www.starwarsccg.org/cardlists/VMasterType.html 21 July 2012], [https://web.archive.org/web/20121211203905/http://www.starwarsccg.org/cardlists/VMasterType.html 11 December 2012], [https://web.archive.org/web/20130111135545/http://www.starwarsccg.org/cardlists/VMasterType.html 11 January 2013]. Later captures carry no game text.</ref>: “Deploy on Sidious. If with [Virtual Block 5] Expand the Empire during your control phase: relocate this card to an [Episode I] Jedi at a battleground or Senate (otherwise, retrieve 1 Force). If on a Jedi, add one battle destiny here, and if that Jedi just lost, relocate this card to Sidious.” '''What changed:''' “Expand The Empire” is written “Expand the Empire”, with a small t. The same wording is already in the Holotable card data of 29 May 2010<ref name="cdf-1250_20">[https://github.com/ledwards/swccgvkit/blob/5047de0/db/darkside.cdf Holotable card data file, version 29 May 2010] (Holotable data, copy on GitHub). Card data is evidence only, not a card document.</ref>; that data is named only as evidence that the wording existed, not as a publication, and the version is dated by the card list. Icons written out in words, straight single quotes and credit lines in the list are not changes. '''Document:''' a text list on the website, with no card image.
* '''PC-E2''' ([[Order 66 (Errata 2)]]): Players Committee card image ([[:File:VB5-D-order66-pre.gif]]): “Deploy on Sidious. If with [Virtual Block 5] Expand The Empire during your control phase: relocate this card to an [Episode I] Jedi at a battleground or Senate (otherwise, retrieve 1 Force). If on a Jedi, add one battle destiny here, and if that Jedi just lost, relocate this card to Sidious.” '''What changed:''' the card-list changes are undone: the image prints the original words of [[Order 66]] again, character for character. It is listed as its own version because it was published (Bill, 11 November 2026: every publication is a version, even a word-for-word repeat). '''Date:''' placed at its server upload date, 25 February 2013, when the Players Committee server received the Virtual Block 1–7 card images. The image may have been made earlier (Players Committee card images go back to the first Legacy releases), but nothing firmer dates it, so it is placed at the upload date (Bill, 11 November 2026: a PC card image is its own version, placed at its date; what was published last counts as current). '''Document:''' Players Committee card image; slip number “20” bottom right, as on the release-sheet slip, the Virtual Block 5 set mark, the whole card with the Decipher art.
* '''PC-E3''' ([[Order 66 (Errata 3)]]): Master List (Dark Side p. 30), official text as of 27 April 2013<ref name="ml-ds">[[Media:Virtual_Legacy_Final_Master_DS.pdf|Players Committee Virtual Cards Master List (Dark Side)]], cover "official text as of April 27, 2013" (PDF built February 2014). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20170704232650/http://www.starwarsccg.org/Resources/MasterDS.pdf#page=30 Internet Archive]</ref>: “Deploy on Sidious. If with [Virtual Block 5] Expand The Empire during your control phase: relocate this card to an [Episode I] Jedi at a battleground or Senate (otherwise, retrieve 1 Force). If on a Jedi, add one battle destiny here, and if that Jedi just lost, relocate this card to Sidious.” The Master List slip ([[:File:VL-history-1250-20-master.png]]) prints it. '''What changed:''' nothing against PC-E2; the Master List also prints the original words of [[Order 66]] again, character for character. It is listed as its own version because it was published (Bill, 11 November 2026: every publication is a version, even a word-for-word repeat). '''Document:''' Master List slip; no slip number (the release-sheet slip and the card image print “20”), the Virtual Block 5 set mark. The Master List slip also prints the Sidious icon beside the game-text box; the Players Committee card image prints it beside the lore box.
